question: Why did the already-failed B1-A0 construction produce severe false-block and transition disagreement on consumed Development Selection evidence?

analysis.false_block_source_decomposition: Exclusive partition of truth-clear/predicted-occupied cells into clearance-threshold crossing, state/clearance consistency failure, predicted-ground-invalid consistency failure, or unresolved aggregate evidence.
analysis.state_distribution: Truth and prediction tri-state counts are reported separately; truth UNKNOWN is excluded from error denominators and is never negative.
analysis.clearance_residual: predicted_clearance_m minus truth_clearance_m on independently paired-valid bands; signed bias, absolute error, negative fraction and linear association are diagnostic only.
analysis.boundary_margin_definition: For truth-clear cells, nonnegative truth clearance above that cell horizon; bins are <=0.10m, (0.10,0.25]m, (0.25,0.50]m and >0.50m.
analysis.transition_failure_partition: Stable truth/prediction state pairs, stable truth/prediction jitter, missed truth transition, or disagreeing transitions; threshold-near is reported both for either endpoint truth-clearance distance <=0.10m and for either truth or prediction clearance distance <=0.10m from that cell horizon.
analysis.cross_seed_similarity: Pairwise prediction-state agreement, false-block-mask Jaccard, transition-failure-mask Jaccard and keyed clearance-residual correlation; all three seeds retained with no winner.
analysis.causal_limit: Frame-level aggregate observations can diagnose residual patterns and consistency but cannot causally separate dense-depth scale, ground/support estimation and upstream image representation.

claim_ceiling: Post-outcome, Development-Selection-only diagnostic anatomy of the permanently frozen negative B1-A0 construction. NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PROMOTION. No causal identification, retuning, seed selection, Calibration, Confirmation, deployment, teacher, temporal, product or safety authority.
